ew_ui_actor_detail_tab_levels_descriptio: Shows this unit's current level and total accumulated bonuses, without per-level history.

ew_ui_no_public_parameters: This module currently has no standalone public parameters. Its fixed rules still follow the design docs and runtime rules.
ew_debug_enabled Description: Shows the EraWheel debug button on the main tab after the mod reloads.
ew_debug_enable_actor_detail_patch Descr: Controls the extra actor detail stat rows and level tab. Turn it off to isolate whether the actor detail patch causes the freeze.
ew_debug_enable_kingdom_detail_patch Des: Controls the extra kingdom detail stat rows and renown tab. Turn it off to isolate whether the kingdom detail patch causes the freeze.
ew_debug_enable_top_tab_retry_verbose_lo: Controls whether delayed top-tab retries keep writing detailed logs on a throttled interval after the first failure.
ew_debug_runtime_hint: This panel now also exposes EW-051 debug actions. Jumping stages, resetting seals, and forcing reconstruction will directly mutate runtime state, so back up real saves first.
ew_debug_reload_hint_restart_required: Method hotfix failed. This change needs a full game restart.
ew_debug_reload_hint_failed: Whole-mod hot reload failed. Check the logs.
